natural_body: 40% SMB discount: signup +31%, revenue +18%, but retention -12%; no renewal.

first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding is the current leading action because both onboarding completion and activation are declining, and prior evidence indicates durable activation and time-to-value gains. Promotional pricing directly addresses competitive pressure but has recorded retention harm and no renewal, creating long-term qualified-revenue risk; verify that record before ruling it out conclusively.
